@seafoox following your proposal, I submitted #765 which change:

* social github button
* lower down big white blank space by adding more text
* use font-weight normal on widget names in doc
* low contrast on code in white background areas
* various text fixes formatting that we missed or introduced recently

Also anchors were already done in the doc webpage.

There's an issue for bower already #351

And as for the links on the homepage I think we are good as we want people to really scroll and get the effect

Thanks a lot for the feedback and sorry for the verrrrrrrrrrry late reply.
